plugins.name: luna-correlate
plugins.description: Offline health-factor correlation MCP (Posture A). Cross-references local health/status series against external factors — Kp geomagnetic index (date-only) and location factors (barometric pressure, pollen, air-quality) resolved offline via a proximity index — and surfaces ranked CANDIDATE signals with caveats; never a diagnosis, never causation. Only the gated factors.cache fetcher touches the network (country-level grid, no PHI, no operator coordinates).

plugins.name: himmel-ops
plugins.description: Harness-meta operational skills for himmel. Load-on-trigger guardrail-recovery playbook (stuck-playbook) that surfaces escape-hatches when an auto-mode write is denied, a Bash command falls through to the classifier, a permission prompt hangs, or a pre-push gate fails — so operational/troubleshooting rules stay out of the always-on root CLAUDE.md (HIMMEL-211).

plugins.name: handover
plugins.description: Handover tracking system — manages epics, tasks, standalones, and session handovers

plugins.name: pr-review-toolkit-himmel
plugins.description: [yotamleo minimal fork] Vendored code-reviewer agent from pr-review-toolkit + HIMMEL-178 verify-before-critical sub-rule patch. Other 5 agents stay upstream (use pr-review-toolkit:* namespace). See marketplace/plugins/pr-review-toolkit-himmel/README.md for the fork rationale + upstream-watch protocol.

plugins.name: telegram-himmel
plugins.description: [yotamleo fork] Telegram channel plugin with the getUpdates poller gated behind TELEGRAM_OWN_POLLER=1, so only the designated owner session polls and ad-hoc claude windows can't steal the single bot-token poll slot. Forked from telegram@claude-plugins-official v0.0.6 — see marketplace/plugins/telegram-himmel/README.md.

plugins.name: qmd
plugins.description: [yotamleo fork of tobi/qmd] Local markdown search plugin re-pointed at a SHARED HTTP MCP daemon (http://localhost:8181/mcp) instead of a per-session stdio server, so every Claude session addresses ONE qmd index runtime (HIMMEL-592). Skill name (qmd:qmd) and MCP tool prefix (mcp__plugin_qmd_qmd__*) unchanged from upstream. Daemon brought up lazily by the plugin's own SessionStart hook (${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ensure-qmd-daemon.sh) so it works from any session/repo with the plugin enabled. See marketplace/plugins/qmd/README.md.

plugins.name: obsidian-triage
plugins.description: Autonomous triage + cross-clip synthesis for Obsidian Web Clipper output. /triage-clips summarizes each clip, infers tags from the existing vault tag set, suggests Related Notes via link-graph proximity, extracts Action Items to today's daily note, annotates a Promotion candidate, marks processed:true (idempotent). /synthesize-clips finds recurring patterns across processed clips and writes vault-restructuring proposals.

plugins.name: lean-skills
plugins.description: [himmel vendor, no carried delta] The subset of upstream skills himmel actually invokes, copied verbatim so a session lists 13 skills instead of the 25 that superpowers@claude-plugins-official and mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official bring between them. Carries 11 of superpowers' 14 (the four himmel uses plus the seven they hand off to - the `superpowers:<name>` reference closure) and grilling from mattpocock/skills; drops using-superpowers, whose SessionStart injection is most of the reclaimed context. Also hosts himmel's own context7-mcp skill, moved out of ~/.claude/skills because plugin membership is the only lever that scopes a skill to a profile. Upstream advance is detected at the release level by the superpowers-skills and mattpocock-skills rows in scripts/upstreams.json; repair is a reviewed re-vendor, never a synced_base bump. See marketplace/plugins/lean-skills/VENDORED.md.

plugins.name: claude-obsidian
plugins.description: Claude + Obsidian knowledge companion (upstream AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian, v2.2.0 — native Windows compatibility: read-only ops with symlink+junction rejection, fail-closed native writes, CRLF binary-mode fixes, CRLF frontmatter parsing). Wiki query, save, ingest, lint, autoresearch. Companion to obsidian-triage — its wiki-query skill optionally powers the Phase 4 Related Notes link-graph traversal. Sourced via an explicit HTTPS git url (NOT the `github` shorthand, which clones over SSH and fails host-key verification on a fresh machine with no github.com in ~/.ssh/known_hosts — HIMMEL-549). Pinned to an immutable tag per himmel supply-chain policy (a bare commit SHA is NOT installable — `claude plugin install` clones via `git clone --branch <ref>`, which only resolves branch/tag names; see marketplace/plugins/obsidian-triage/README.md § Pin update workflow). Fork `yotamleo/claude-obsidian` retired at v2.2.0 — its delta (#178 UTF-8 guards, #179 CRLF report) landed upstream (HIMMEL-2925).

plugins.name: plannotator-effective-html
plugins.description: [plannotator, vendor + attribution only, no carried delta] Effective HTML annotation/plugin tooling. Sourced via an explicit HTTPS git url (NOT the `github` shorthand, which clones over SSH and fails host-key verification on a fresh machine with no github.com in ~/.ssh/known_hosts — HIMMEL-2837, same class as HIMMEL-549). Pinned to an upstream commit SHA per himmel supply-chain policy. Upstream companion PR merged: https://github.com/plannotator/effective-html/pull/26 (their own marketplace.json now uses the same explicit-url source; pin includes it, HIMMEL-3046).
